sloka: मलदाः च करूषाः च मम अंग मल धारिणौ ।साधु साधु इति तम् देवाः पाकशासनम् अब्रुवन् ॥१-२४-२३॥
transliteration: maladāḥ ca karūṣāḥ ca mama aṁga mala dhāriṇau ।sādhu sādhu iti tam devāḥ pākaśāsanam abruvan ॥1-24-23॥

translations.english: Having seen the honour bestowed on that land by the wise Indra, the gods said to him, 'Well done, Well done'.
